descriptionChirho: To seize or apprehend someone in the very act of wrongdoing, implying being caught red-handed in a transgression. Used in John 8:3-4 of the woman caught in adultery (κατειλημμένην, κατείληπται). Rendered Arabic مقبوضة, Hebrew נִתְפְּסָה, Hindi पकड़ी गई, Korean 잡힌, Spanish sorprendida.

To overtake, come upon, or overwhelm someone or something, often used of darkness, adversity, or calamity catching up with a person unexpectedly. Used of an unclean spirit seizing someone (Mark 9:18), darkness not overcoming the light (John 1:5), darkness overtaking a person walking without light (John 12:35), and the day of the Lord not overtaking believers as a thief (1 Thess 5:4). Rendered Arabic يأخذ/تدرك, Hebrew תָפַשׂ/הִשִּׂיג, Korean 덮치다/붙잡다, Spanish alcanzar/agarrar.

To grasp with the mind, understand, perceive, or discern something intellectually or spiritually. Used of the apostles' associates perceiving that they were uneducated (Acts 4:13), Peter perceiving that God shows no partiality (Acts 10:34), Paul understanding that the accused had done nothing deserving death (Acts 25:25), and believers being able to comprehend the breadth and depth of Christ's love (Eph 3:18). Rendered Arabic أدرك, Hebrew הֵבִינוּ/מָצָאתִי, Hindi समझना, Korean 깨닫다/알다, Spanish comprender.

To actively seize, obtain, or attain a goal, prize, or objective through determined pursuit, often in a metaphorical/spiritual context. Used of Gentiles who attained righteousness (Rom 9:30), running to obtain the prize (1 Cor 9:24), Paul pressing on to lay hold of that for which Christ laid hold of him (Phil 3:12-13). Rendered Arabic أدرك, Hebrew הִשִּׂיג/אַשִּׂיג, Hindi पकड़ना/प्राप्त करना, Korean 잡다/얻다, Spanish alcanzar/obtener.

To be laid hold of or seized by another in the passive voice, describing being grasped or apprehended by a person or by divine power. Used in Phil 3:12 where Paul says he was laid hold of (κατελήμφθην) by Christ Jesus, indicating divine initiative in calling and claiming the apostle. Rendered Arabic أُدرِكْتُ, Hebrew הֻשַּׂגְתִּי, Hindi पकड़ गया, Korean 붙잡혔노라, Spanish fui alcanzado.
